vector_length_check: Per core, ticks[5] is the e32,m1 VL from warmup, ticks[6] is the VL CSR after timed tile calls; both must match the tile width.
work_assignment: Each core owns a fixed contiguous quarter of the tiles on every pass.
source_coordinates: For tile t, h=t%16 and g=t//16. Use head h, rows starting at 4*((4*g+h)%64), columns starting at 8*((g+3*h)%32).
metric: Wall interval on core 0 across dispatch and join, divided by all timed scores on four cores. Each process warms the same tile kernel on all four cores before measurement. UART wall includes startup, input loading and the untimed warm pass. Timing is throughput.
scalar_register_allocation: 22 FP32 accumulators stay in FP registers, ten keep their FP32 bits in caller-saved integer registers. No stack memory is used by either inner K loop. Both leaves preserve the same twelve callee-saved FP registers outside the K loop.
selection_rule: For both batches RVV must have a lower median ns/score, win more than half of the pairs and have positive median paired scalar-minus-RVV time. All trials were retained.
decision: Use scalar; the 4x8 short loop did not qualify for testing on the original full score graph.
